gcp.secretmanager.access.note: Access operations beyond the free 10,000 a month (the SKU's first tier). One SKU for every location; it is not listed under "global", so sync reads it in us-central1.

gcp.secretmanager.versions.note: Active secret version per location; automatic replication counts as one location. The catalog prices a version-month ($0.06), 730 version-hours. The first 6 versions (the SKU's first tier) are free and ignored.
